Step:  
06-16-1507 minus 178 days.  
1507 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
Days in months before June 1507: Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31.  
From Jun 16 back to Jun 1 = 15 days.  
178 − 15 = 163 days earlier than Jun 1.  
May 31 → 1 day back to May 31 (already counted in Jun 1 back). Actually:  
Count back from Jun 1:  
May: 31 days → back to May 1 uses 31 days, remaining 163 − 31 = 132.  
April: 30 days → back to Apr 1 uses 30 days, remaining 102.  
March: 31 days → back to Mar 1 uses 31 days, remaining 71.  
February: 28 days → back to Feb 1 uses 28 days, remaining 43.  
January: 31 days → back to Jan 1 uses 31 days, remaining 12.  
Dec 1506: 31 days → Dec 31 back 12 days = Dec 20, 1506.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1506-12-20
